message: Race Off variant-label hotfix: v8.0.89 restored Car History BACK successfully, but its stale-ID catalogue fallback referenced FH5_CATALOGUE through window even though the catalogue is a top-level const. v8.0.90 uses the real catalogue binding, so completed and pending frozen Race Off snapshots can distinguish same-year variants such as Morris Minor 1000 (Cult Cars) and Morris Minor 1000 Forza Edition (Track Toys). All v8.0.89 History, v8.0.88 career, v8.0.87 LOCATION, Evil bridge and Results/Corrections behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
